final_codes.title: Pre-eclampsia
final_codes.reasoning: The patient meets diagnostic criteria for pre-eclampsia beyond 20 weeks gestation, presenting with persistent severe hypertension, proteinuria (2+), visual symptoms, headache, and right upper quadrant abdominal tenderness. Per GDL-009, this presentation should be coded as pre-eclampsia rather than isolated headache or abdominal pain.
